claim: For the right-tail regime of Deuchert--Li's canonical ideal-Bose-gas large-deviation theorem with \(\alpha>1\) and \(b>b_c\), put \(r=(b_c/b)^\alpha\), \(\eta_{\max}=r/(1-r)\), and, for \(0<\eta<\eta_{\max}\), let \(z(\eta)\in(0,1)\) be the unique solution of \(\operatorname{Li}_{\alpha}(z)=\zeta(\alpha)[1-(1-r)\eta/r]\). Then the positive right-tail rate is exactly \[J(\eta)=\frac{r}{\zeta(\alpha)}[\zeta(\alpha+1)-\operatorname{Li}_{\alpha+1}(z)]+[r-(1-r)\eta]\log z.\] It is strictly increasing and strictly convex, with \(J'(\eta)=-(1-r)\log z\) and \(J''(\eta)=(1-r)^2\zeta(\alpha)/(r\operatorname{Li}_{\alpha-1}(z))>0\), and its one-sided endpoint cost is \(\lim_{\eta\uparrow\eta_{\max}}J(\eta)=r\zeta(\alpha+1)/\zeta(\alpha)\). As \(\eta\downarrow0\), its local geometry has three regimes: \(J(\eta)\sim C_{\alpha,r}\eta^{\alpha/(\alpha-1)}\) for \(1<\alpha<2\), \(J(\eta)\sim (1-r)^2\zeta(2)\eta^2/[2r|\log\eta|]\) for \(\alpha=2\), and \(J(\eta)\sim (1-r)^2\zeta(\alpha)\eta^2/[2r\zeta(\alpha-1)]\) for \(\alpha>2\), where \(C_{\alpha,r}=\frac{\alpha-1}{\alpha}(1-r)[\zeta(\alpha)(1-r)/(r[-\Gamma(1-\alpha)])]^{1/(\alpha-1)}\).
integrity: The closed form is derived from the published variational exponent; the saddle equation, derivatives, endpoint limit, and local asymptotics are independently checked by the bundled numerical verifier.
scientific_limitations: Only the alpha>1 right-tail regime inside the open admissible interval is covered.
The exact threshold event at eta_max is not determined; only the one-sided interior-rate limit is proved.
The small-eta phase diagram is a property of the fixed-deviation rate and is not a uniform moderate-deviation theorem.
title: Polylogarithmic geometry of the canonical ideal-Bose condensate right tail
